isolation: Temporary SQLite/artifacts for API and engine checks; dedicated local simulation-logic-audit DB/artifacts for desktop flows. No existing production scenario was edited by these tests.

confirmed_defects.problem: A service completing exactly at supply depletion or disruption onset was paused with zero remaining care until recovery.
confirmed_defects.controlled_example: 12-hour completed ward care plus a shortage from12h through24h discharged at24h; current1.2 correctly discharges at12h.
confirmed_defects.fix: Keep completed service events valid while continuing to block new care during the shortage.
confirmed_defects.backward_compatibility: Frozen1.0 and1.1 jobs retain their original trajectories and can still regenerate traces, exports, branches and matching-version comparisons.

verified_rules: 7/14/30-day global arrival curves and late daily edits reach actual event arrivals; zero days, reductions, surges and unchanged-day paired identities reconcile.
Bed counts, staffed limits, nurses, providers, support and patient-specific oxygen independently bound new admissions;36 controlled resource cases have exact admission waves and queue integrals.
Severity changes only newly arriving inpatient/stepdown care duration; separate assessments, routing, initial residuals and paired arrivals remain stable.
Disruptions and stock exhaustion pause unfinished care, retain patient locations, continue arrivals, prevent starts and resume exact residuals; overlaps form a union.
Supplies remain0–100%, active-care consumption and capped refills conserve stock, and DST25-hour days use elapsed-weighted daily/overall percentages.
Patient/event ledgers independently reconstruct conservation, occupancy, waiting including unfinished queues, admission/ED metrics and success eligibility.
Missing or no-arrival measures stay unavailable; overlapping constraint categories are not added as independent patient burden.
Real paired comparisons freeze input revisions/seeds/models, rank measured improvements, save the evaluated plan and reject stale or mismatched recommendations.
Desktop flows verify edits/save/reload/run/Summary/Analytics/bookmarks/Replay at recorded bottlenecks/Comparison/saveplan, including reconstruction of an unretained source.
model_semantics_to_keep_visible: Success score is first treatment within24 elapsed hours among eligible arrivals; it does not mean admission within24h or clinical outcome.
Staff/equipment loss restricts new placements and reports existing occupied deficits without ejecting patients, as specified; supply outages and explicit disruptions pause care clocks.
limits: Finite engineering scenarios and seeded regressions cannot prove every possible input combination.
Synthetic durations, resource ratios and access targets were not calibrated against observed hospital operations.
